fields.title: Pay 25% of the total on the day of purchase then pay the remaining balance as three equal monthly payments

fields.editor: Spend between £500 - £1,000 on servicing or repairs at KAM Servicing, pay just 25% now and spread the balance equally over the following 3 months. There are no lengthy forms to be completed, so as long as you have a UK-registered debit card with sufficient funds to cover the 25% initial deposit, you can take advantage of the scheme.
You pay 25% of the bill on your debit card. Three further equal payments will be taken monthly from your debit card.

Pay on the day £150

 1st Payment £150 (30 days later)

 2nd Payment £150 (60 days later)

 3rd Payment £150 (90 days later)

For more information, please speak to your local branch manager. Payment Assist is the number one service provider of retail finance in the automotive aftermarket. As a responsible lender, Payment Assist Ltd complies fully with the requirements of the Financial Conduct Authority FRN 622544 and the Data Protection Act: A8041970. Any personal information supplied will not be shared with third parties.
